title: Allow `pyarrow` CI to fail
body:
This is a follow-up to https://github.com/dask/dask/pull/10097. Now that `pandas=2.0` is out we can now run our `dataframe.convert-string=True` CI build without `continue-on-error: ${{ matrix.extra == 'pyarrow' }}`. Previously we allowed failures in this build because (prior to the `pandas=2.0` release) we needed to use the nightly `pandas` wheel and would pull encounter unrelated failures due to, for example, some non-`pyarrow` related deprecations. 

cc @j-bennet @phofl for visibility
